name: Context Active Inspector
description: Adds an admin toolbar tray that lists the Context-module contexts active on the current page, for debugging conditions/reactions.
project_description:
Features 
 Toolbar item that provides inspector of active contexts and navigation within.

 Requirements 
 Context module.

 Configuration 
 Set permission `access context active inspector` for admin users.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Gin , Gin Toolbar , Admin Toolbar Language Switcher .
